subject: Request: Promotional top-up credit routing for Paragon trial
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Andrew Choi <andrew@paragon.ai>
Date: Fri, 29 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Promotional top-up credit routing for Paragon trial

Team —

Paragon (PAR-3245) hit their trial cap last night and asked us to apply the additional promotional top-up we agreed to in last week's call. They want the credit to be applied ASAP so it reduces the upcoming invoice. I’ve attached the usage report and a quick proforma credit memo.

Question for finance: do we want to issue a credit memo against the current open invoice (invoice #INV-8872) or post a contra receivable (journal) and then net on the next billing run? Accounting prefers consistent ledger treatment across trials so we don’t create reconciliation churn.

Customer note: Andrew confirmed via Slack they prefer the amount to be reflected on the next invoice so it shows as a reduction rather than a separate credit line, but they’re OK with either as long as it’s visible.

Can you advise GL account and the preferred posting approach? Also flag any approvals needed so I can loop in Sales Ops/Legal.

Thanks —
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0192

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Jul 2028 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Promotional top-up credit routing for Paragon trial

Logan —

Thanks for the context and the attachments. A few follow-ups before we pick a path:

- Confirm amount to apply (I see $12,500 on the proforma).
- Confirm which invoice to offset (INV-8872 or next open).
- Provide the contractual note that authorized the promo (deal comment or email OK).

Our preference is to post a credit memo and offset the specific invoice when there is an open invoice to offset. If the invoice is already closed/paid, we post a contra receivable (journal) and then apply as a payment on the next invoice run.

For GL mapping: Promotional credits should be posted to Revenue Contra GL 4109 and the counterpart to Promo Accrual 2330 per current policy. If legal or sales discount approval is required (>$10k) we need a written approval in the deal.

I’ll prepare the journal entry template once you confirm the amount and which invoice to target.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Accounting Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>

Attached is the email thread from last Monday where I committed to the top-up (excerpt below). If the >$10k threshold triggers an internal approval, please flag who in Sales Ops needs to sign off.

Logan

Per the policy and given the amount ($12,500), this needs a single Sales Ops approval. @Neha, can you confirm and record approval in HubSpot? Once Neha confirms, Finance Ops will:

I’ve attached a blank "journal_entry_template.xlsx" for the posting.

-Marcus
